_meta.purpose: B-20 cliche scanner dictionary. Detects period-stereotype phrases in source_prompt that may have no historical basis (e.g. 'stereotype phrases were added without verification in past sessions). WARN-level only; user opt-out via visual.cliche_acks.
categories: smoking: tobacco-stereotyped scenes (often added without historical basis)
atmosphere: atmospheric stereotypes (gas lamps, candle-lit, etc.)
pose: stereotyped poses (gesturing animatedly, posing for portrait)
anachronism: items/settings inappropriate to the era
